headline: Mar Vista Hills Wellness Retreat
articleBody:
1,300 sq ft therapeutic pavilion with hydrotherapy pool, infrared sauna array, and zen raked gravel garden. Passive ventilation maintains 74°F year-round. Rooftop solar array powers all features.

Outcome: 11-week execution. 58% energy savings verified. Corporate meditation retreats booked weekly. Featured in Mindful magazine.
